chunks: What Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb narrated from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Mughīrah, from Abū al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about ghusl on the day of Jumuʿah, and he said: It is obligatory upon every male and female, whether slave or free.

key_terms.أُنْثَى: female person included in the ruling
key_terms.الْغُسْلِ: ritual bath being asked about in the narration
key_terms.حُرٍّ: free person included in the ruling
key_terms.ذَكَرٍ: male person included in the ruling
key_terms.عَبْدٍ: enslaved person included in the ruling
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ: the day of Friday, the specific time connected to the ruling

ai.seo_question: Is ghusl on Friday obligatory for all Muslims according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states the ruling of performing ghusl on the day of Jumuʿah. It presents the obligation in universal terms, applying to every male and female, whether enslaved or free.
